trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document) WHERE p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] RETURN p.position AS col1, MIN(CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64)) AS col2 ORDER BY col1

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WITH CASE WHEN p.position IN ['Center', 'Forward', 'Power Forward', 'Small Forward', 'F', 'C', 'FC', 'F-C'] THEN 'Frontcourt' WHEN p.position IN ['Guard', 'Point Guard', 'Shooting Guard', 'G', 'PG', 'SG', 'G-F', 'F-G'] THEN 'Backcourt' END AS position_group, p WHERE position_group IS NOT NULL RETURN position_group AS col1, MIN(CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64)) AS col2 ORDER BY col1
